svg.title: load in a Claude Code session
svg.desc: The spinner reads: Gusting… ~3m left. The status line under the prompt reads: ⚠ load: ██░░░░░░ ~3m left · est 4m · Build CLI calculator, tests, commit, push. The countdown pauses while Claude waits for an answer, re-estimates when it runs out, and ends with: Done in 5m (estimated 4m) · 3m waiting on you.
